text: 1. Applicants under 18 years old (until September 1, 2023) should provide a letter of guarantee for their guardian in China (should be notarized by relevant authorities).*2. School ProfileE.g. Overall Introduction, Admission Requirement, Enrollment Rate, Curriculum, Grading System, University Acceptance of Graduates and etc.*3. Birth Certificate*4. The nationality or household registration certificate of both the applicant's parents (Passport or ID card)*5. Personal statement with signature6. Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens should provide the following materials1 Certificate of the applicant obtained foreign nationality at birth or afterward.2 For applicants who obtained foreign nationality at birth, 1) if one or both of the parents are Chinese citizens and have a permanent residence abroad, a certificate of the corresponding permanent residence needs to be provided; 2) if one or both of the parents are Chinese citizens but have not obtained permanent residence abroad, certificate of the renunciation of the Chinese nationality of the applicant needs to be provided.3 For applicants who were originally Chinese citizens and obtained foreign nationalities afterward, a certificate for the cancellation of their original registered residence in China and the renunciation of the Chinese nationality should be provided.4 The entry and exit seal page of visiting China on the applicant's passport from April 30, 2021 to the time of application.*7. Chinese language certificateCertificate of HSK*8. Two recommendation letters, at least one of which has to be provided by one of the academic teachers in the high school (with signature)*9. Passport information page (valid for more than 6 months)With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included*10. Passport photoA recent passport-sized photo of the applicant*11. Academic certificate1 High school official transcripts, including all courses taken. 2025 graduating students should provide the high school official transcripts of all courses which have completed before the application;2 Test scores of the national high school graduation exam or college entrance exam in the country or region, such as SAT (code:9184)/ ACT (code: 3038)/ IB (code: N010601)/ A-level /UEC, etc. If the above test score reports cannot be provided at application stage, an explanation document must be provided;*12. Senior high school diploma or equivalent2025 graduating students should provide an official statement from your high school as proof of graduation13. Applicants applying for designing will need to submit portfolios.14. Award certificates (if any).*15. Financial guarantee proven deposit of not less than RMB 100,000 (or equivalent in foreign currency).
